product_overview: AYE Platform is a zero-PII, developer-controlled university accountability system where verified students anonymously report campus issues, collaborate in real time, and track institutional resolution performance. It supports strict college silos, ghost-handle identity, anti-troll enforcement, and public Reality Grade scoreboards.
core_goals: Enable anonymous but verified student issue reporting without collecting personal identifiable information
Keep each student strictly scoped to their own college’s campus wall, chat, and polls
Provide self-hosted authentication using classmate OTP or campus GPS verification
Support evidence-backed issue tracking with AYE votes, crowd proofs, and resolution polls
Automate anti-troll moderation with junk flags, strikes, and hardware fingerprint bans
Expose public college scoreboards and Reality Grades based on issue resolution performance
Give the Developer Super-Admin full control over colleges, bans, campaigns, and issue administration

features.name: Zero-PII Authentication and College Verification
features.description: Students register and sign in using ghost handles, passwords, and either a classmate-generated OTP or campus GPS verification, without collecting real-world identity data.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/colleges to browse available colleges -> Receive 200 with college list and Reality Scores -> POST /api/v1/auth/verify-gps with lat/lng inside campus geofence -> Receive 200 with verification success -> POST /api/v1/auth/register with college_id, ghost_handle, password, course_branch, study_year, hardware_fingerprint_hash, and valid GPS/OTP proof -> Receive 201 with JWT and secret recovery key

GET /api/v1/auth/generate-otp with authenticated student credentials -> Receive 200 with 6-digit OTP valid for 120 seconds -> POST /api/v1/auth/register with college_id, ghost_handle, password, course_branch, study_year, hardware_fingerprint_hash, and otp_code -> Receive 201 with JWT and secret recovery key -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with JWT -> Receive 200 with current zero-PII profile

POST /api/v1/auth/register with an expired or invalid otp_code -> Receive 400 with validation error -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with ghost_handle, password, and hardware_fingerprint_hash -> Receive 401 or 403 when fingerprint is banned or credentials are invalid

POST /api/v1/auth/recover with ghost_handle and invalid secret_recovery_key -> Receive 400 or 401 recovery failure -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with old password -> Receive 401 unauthorized because password was not reset

features.name: Campus Wall Experience Reporting
features.description: Students create structured campus problem posts with required fields, media evidence, and optional hidden ghost-handle display, then browse and filter issue feeds limited to their own college.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/experiences with title, what_is_wrong, exact_location, impact_scope, category, severity, media files, and hide_handle preference -> Receive 201 with created experience -> GET /api/v1/experiences with status and category filters -> Receive 200 with college-scoped feed containing the new post -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 with full post details and media evidence

POST /api/v1/experiences with missing required structured fields or invalid media payload -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id for a nonexistent post -> Receive 404 not found

GET /api/v1/experiences with sort=oldest_unresolved and category=LABS_WIFI -> Receive 200 with filtered results -> POST /api/v1/experiences with a post from another college context -> Receive 403 forbidden because the feed is auto-filtered by the authenticated user’s college

features.name: AYE Voting, Junk Flagging, and Crowd Proofs
features.description: Users can support serious posts with AYE votes, challenge troll content with junk flags, and add independent proof media to strengthen a report.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/aye on an unresolved post -> Receive 200 and increment aye_count -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 showing updated AYE total

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/flag-junk on a joke or non-serious post -> Receive 200 and increment junk_flag_count -> POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/flag-junk again from the same user -> Receive 409 because duplicate junk votes are prevented by unique constraints

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/crowd-proof with proof_media_url and optional comment_text -> Receive 201 and attach evidence to the post -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 with the new crowd proof visible

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/aye with a malformed post ID or inaccessible post -> Receive 404 or 403 error -> POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/crowd-proof without proof media -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Issue Escalation and Resolution Polls
features.description: Highly supported issues automatically trend, and students can propose fixes and vote on whether the issue is actually resolved.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/aye repeatedly until aye_count reaches 25 -> Receive 200 on each vote -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 showing status updated to TRENDING and linked chat room created

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/propose-fix with fix_proof_media_url and fix_note -> Receive 200 or 201 with status changed to FIX_PROPOSED -> GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 with active resolution poll

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/vote-fix with yes/no on an active poll -> Receive 200 and update poll vote counts -> After total votes reach 10, GET /api/v1/experiences/:id -> Receive 200 showing status RESOLVED or UNRESOLVED based on vote outcome

POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/propose-fix without required fix proof media -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/vote-fix when no active resolution poll exists -> Receive 409 or 404 poll not available

features.name: Real-Time AYE Lounge Chat
features.description: Students participate in college-scoped real-time chat rooms, including global, branch, issue-linked, and DM-style rooms, with message history available through the API.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/chat/rooms -> Receive 200 with all chat rooms for the authenticated college -> GET /api/v1/chat/rooms/:roomId/messages -> Receive 200 with message history -> POST /api/v1/chat/rooms/:roomId/messages with content and optional media_url -> Receive 201 and message appears in the room

POST /api/v1/chat/rooms/:roomId/messages with an invalid room ID -> Receive 404 room not found -> GET /api/v1/chat/rooms/:roomId/messages for a room outside the user’s college silo -> Receive 403 forbidden
GET /api/v1/chat/rooms without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/v1/chat/rooms/:roomId/messages as a banned user -> Receive 403 blocked by account status

features.name: Encrypted File Uploads
features.description: Users upload and retrieve media files used for experience posts, crowd proofs, and fix evidence, with stored assets protected by encryption.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/upload with a valid image or video file -> Receive 201 with stored file reference -> Use returned storedName in POST /api/v1/experiences or POST /api/v1/experiences/:id/crowd-proof -> Receive success and linked media URL
GET /api/v1/files/:storedName for an authorized uploaded asset -> Receive 200 with encrypted file download -> GET /api/v1/files/:storedName for a missing file -> Receive 404 not found
POST /api/v1/upload with unsupported file type or oversized payload -> Receive 400 validation error or 413 payload too large

features.name: Public College Scoreboard and Reality Grade
features.description: Anyone can view a public college scoreboard page that shows resolution performance, grade, and issue metrics without exposing private student identity.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/colleges -> Receive 200 with public college list, resolution rates, and Reality Grades -> Open /c/[slug] using the returned college slug -> Receive public scoreboard data for that college

GET /api/v1/public/scoreboard/:collegeSlug -> Receive 200 with resolved and unresolved issue metrics, grade, and longest-ignored problems -> Refresh the page after a resolution -> Receive updated score and grade
GET /api/v1/public/scoreboard/:collegeSlug for an unknown slug -> Receive 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/colleges with malformed query or server issue -> Receive 500 or validation error

features.name: Developer Super-Admin Console
features.description: The DEV_SUPER_ADMIN can manage colleges, ban users by hardware fingerprint, seed OTPs, and control issue and campaign administration from the private admin console.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/dev-admin/stats -> Receive 200 with admin dashboard metrics -> GET /api/v1/dev-admin/colleges -> Receive 200 with all managed colleges -> POST /api/v1/dev-admin/colleges with name, slug, city, and GPS coordinates -> Receive 201 and new college is added

POST /api/v1/dev-admin/ban-user with user identifier and reason -> Receive 200 and hardware fingerprint is banned -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with that user’s credentials and fingerprint -> Receive 403 because the fingerprint is blocked
GET /api/v1/dev-admin/issues -> Receive 200 with flagged and unresolved issue list -> PATCH /api/v1/dev-admin/issues/:id/status with a new status -> Receive 200 and issue status updates
POST /api/v1/dev-admin/ban-user as a non-DEV_SUPER_ADMIN user -> Receive 403 forbidden -> DELETE /api/v1/dev-admin/campaigns/:id without permission -> Receive 403 unauthorized
